## Flagship Systems & Projects
- [MockPrep.ai](https://github.com/Naimishomar/MockPrep.ai): Real-time AI voice interview simulator with dynamic question generation, interruption handling, and post-interview feedback using Gemini API, ElevenLabs, and WebSockets.
- [QuickML](https://github.com/navneetkumaryadav207001/QuickML): Machine learning & neural network library written from scratch in raw NumPy (autograd, CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, Hopfield Networks, LeNet-5).
- [Confidence Prediction Model](https://huggingface.co/spaces/NavneetYadav207002/Confidence): Computer vision system predicting confidence levels from live webcam streams using PyTorch and ResNet.
